limits: This is current public code-supported behavior, not a newly isolated selected-archive input observation.
Existing bead ticker motion is outside this package; no invented morphTick coupling is added.
Only the two specific source heading strings animate; no repetitive extra text animation.
Phone semicolon is raised24px from the hidden legacy placeholder so the comma clears the static bottom bead rail; source Phone composition remains an explicit adaptation.
Native glyph fitting is fixed to the two declared layout sizes; intermediate widths require a separately reviewed native layout.
Native font must use the actual uploaded italic800 face. Fallback monospace in the pure-Nix motion fixture is explicitly not source typography proof.
Morph initial static CSS path and its animation backend have a measured one-pixel antialias edge difference; exact cubic coordinates and same-backend paused/hold pixels are separately proved.
